description: This file defines the Category entity class within the catalog domain, mapping to the 'category' table in the 'catalog' schema. It includes fields for id, code, name, parent category, and timestamps for creation and update, with lifecycle hooks to set timestamps.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Entity class representing a category in the catalog, including relationships, timestamps, and domain-specific attributes.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to set createdAt and updatedAt timestamps before persisting.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to update the updatedAt timestamp before updating.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the category.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the category.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code of the category.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the category.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the category.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent category, if any.
